svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 336 mm lengths of 12 x 10 mm HDPE bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chamfer the top edges of both ends 2 x 45 degrees so the pack

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each strip lies on the tray along one edge, its outer face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in line with the pack's side (35 to 45 mm from the centre line),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: starting 2 mm from the end stop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fix with three 4 mm countersunk self-tapping screws for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plastic, up from under the tray, 10 mm deep, 120 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pack's back face slides on the two strips, 12 mm above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tray, so its latch clears the tray.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: screw heads below the tray's under face; strips straight.
